coaches.note: end-of-season staff table with no dates: not point-in-time safe (GAP)

espn_schedule.note: carries the tip-off instant (UTC); the only 2026-27 schedule source. status/score columns are post-game

game_rosters.note: who was on the game-day roster; published with the result, so treated as post-game

injuries.note: daily injury-list snapshots, one row per listed player per as_of_date, only from 2026-09-08 on; there is NO free injury history before that (GAP, GG-register)

lineups.note: on-court five per event; action_number repeats inside a game (measured), so it is a join key, not unique

officials.note: crew assignment time is not published; NBA posts crews ~9am game day, but the file is post-game so it is excluded until a timestamp exists (GAP)

pbp.note: action_number is not unique within a game; order_index is

schedule.note: results table: date + teams are pre-game facts, scores are not; no tip time (see espn_schedule)

shots.note: no clean event key in the file; ties on (period, clock, shooter) are legitimate (tip-ins)
